text: Information and Communication Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that studies information transmission, processing, switching and the design of communication systems, integrating electronics, signal processing, computer science and network technology. It focuses on how to efficiently and reliably transmit data (such as voice, images, and videos), from 4G/5G communication networks to satellite remote sensing systems, from smart home interconnection to quantum communication. This major is the "neural network" of the modern information society, supporting the operation of the global information infrastructure.
